senses.gloss:
कच् कच्, cl. 1. A. कचते, चकचे, कचि-
तुम्, to bind; to shine; P. कचति, to
sound, cry; [cf. कञ्च्; cf. also Hib. cacht, ‘a strait,
a narrow place; bonds, fetters.’]

कच, अस्, m. the hair (especially of the head); a
cicatrix, a dry or healed sore, a scar; a binding, band;
the hem of a garment; a cloud; N. of a son of
Bṛhaspati; N. of a place; (आ), f. a female elephant;
beauty, brilliancy; [cf. अ-कच, उत्-कच, &c.]
—कच-
प, अस्, m. ‘cloud-drinker,’ grass; a leaf; (अम्), n.
a vessel for vegetables; a leaf of a vegetable (?).
—कच-पक्ष or कच-पाश, अस्, m. thick or
ornamented hair.
—कच-माल, अस्, m. smoke; (per-
haps a wrong reading for खतमाल?).
—कच-
रिपु-फला, f., N. of a tree; see शमी.
—कच-
हस्त, अस्, m. thick or ornamented hair, a beautiful
head of hair.
—कचा-कचि, ind. hair against hair,
pulling each other's hair.
—कचाचित (˚च-अच्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, having long or dishevelled hair.
—कचामोद
(˚च-आम्˚), अम्, n. a fragrant ointment for the hair.

काच काच, अस्, m. (fr. rt. कच्), glass, crystal
considered as a natural production and used as a jewel
or ornament; alkaline ashes, any salt of potash or
soda in a glassy or crystalline state; a class of diseases
of the eye, especially an affection of the optic nerve
or gutta serena; a loop, a swinging shelf, a string so
fastened to the yoke as to hold or support burdens
&c.; the string of the scale of a balance; (अम्), n.
alkaline salt, black salt; wax.
—काच-कूपी, f. a glass
bottle.
—काच-घटी, f. a glass ewer.
—काच-भा-
जन, अम्, n. a vessel of glass or crystal, a cup, a
goblet.
—काच-मणि, इस्, m. ‘a glass jewel,’ crystal,
quartz.
—काच-मल, अम्, n. black salt or soda.
—काच-लवण, अम्, n. black salt, a medicinal salt,
prepared by calcining fossil salt and the fruit of the
Emblic Myrobalan together; it consists chiefly of
muriate of soda, with a small quantity of iron, lime,
and sulphur, and is a tonic aperient.
—काच-वक-
यन्त्र, अम्, n. a glass retort.
—काच-सम्भव,
अम्, n. black salt.
—काच-सौवर्चल, अम्, n. black
salt.
—काच-स्थाली, f. the trumpet flower, Bignonia
[]
Suaveolens.
—काचाक्ष (˚च-अक्˚), अस्, m. glass-eye,
N. of an aquatic bird.

कचङ्गन कचङ्गन, अम्, n. a free market,
a place of sale paying no duty or custom; [cf. कराङ्-
गण, अङ्गण, and अङ्गन.]

कचङ्गल कचङ्गल, अम्, n. the ocean; N.
of a region.

कचाकु कचाकु, उस्, उस्, उ, ill-disposed,
wicked; intolerable, difficult to be borne; difficult
to be attained; (उस्), m. a snake.

कचाटुर कचाटुर, अस्, m. a gallinule. See
दात्यूह.

कचु कचु, उस्, f. an esculent root, Arum
Colocasia and other kinds, many of which are culti-
vated for food. See कच्वी.

कचेल कचेल, अम्, n. a string or cover con-
taining and keeping together the leaves of a manu-
script; (perhaps a various reading for काचन.)

कच्चट कच्चट, अम्, n. an aquatic plant, =
जलपिप्पली.

कच्चर कच्चर (कद्-चर,) अस्, आ, अम्, dirty,
foul; spoiled, spoiled by dirt; vile, wicked, bad;
(अम्), n. buttermilk diluted with water; [cf. कङ्-
कर, कटुर, &c.]
कच्चिद् कच्-चिद् (= कद्-चिद्). See under 2. कद्.

कच्छ कच्छ, अस्, अम्, m. n. (in the first
sense a Prākṛt form for कक्ष; cf. कच्छटिका),
the hem or end of a lower garment tucked into the
girdle or waistband; (according to some m. f. n. in
the next senses, according to others only m.) a bank
or any ground bordering on water, as the margin of
a river, lake, tank, &c.; a mound or causeway,
watery soil, marshy ground, a marsh, a morass, low or
flat land skirting mountains; N. of several places; (आस्),
m. pl. the people inhabiting them; (अस्), m. a part
of a boat; a particular part of a tortoise; a tree, the
timber of which is used for making furniture &c.,
Cedrela Toona or common Tūn; another tree,
Hibiscus Populneoides; (आ), f. a cricket; the plant
Lycopodium Imbricatum; see वाराही.
—कच्छ-
[]
देश, अस्, m., N. of a place.
—कच्छ-प, अस्,
m. a turtle, a tortoise (as inhabiting marshy
places); a tumour on the palate; an apparatus used
in the distillation of spirituous liquor, a flat kind of
still; an attitude in wrestling; the tree Cedrela
Toona; one of the nine nidhis or treasures of
Kuvera; N. of a Nāga; a son of Viśvā-mitra; N. of
a country; (ई), f. a female tortoise or a small species
of tortoise; a cutaneous disease, wart or blotch; a
kind of lute, also the lute of Sarasvatī (so named from
being similar in shape to the tortoise).
—कच्छ-
प-देश, अस्, m., N. of a place.
—कच्छ-भू,
ऊस्, f. marshy ground, a swamp, a morass.
—कच्छ-
रुहा, f. a kind of grass, Dūrva, Agrostis Linearis,
Panicus Dactilon.
—कच्छ-विहार, अस्, m., N. of
a marshy region.
—कच्छान्त (˚छ-अन्˚), अस्, m.
the border of a lake or stream.
—कच्छेश्वर
(˚छ-ईश्˚), अस्, m., N. of a town.

काच्छ काच्छ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कच्छ), being
on the bank of a river (not applicable to a man).

कच्छटिका or कच्छाटिका or कच्छाटी, f. the
end or hem of a lower garment or cloth gathered up
behind and tucked into the waistband.

कच्छपिका, f. a pimple, a blotch or wart; a
wart accompanying gonorrhœa.
कच्छर, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
कच्छोटिका, f. = कच्छटिका, q. v.

कच्छिय कच्छिय, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people;
(various readings have कक्ष and कच्छ.)

कच्छु कच्छु, उस्, or कच्छू, ऊस्, f. (said to
be fr. rt. कष्), itch, formation of watery pustules on
the hands &c., scab. (The form कच्छू is the older
and more correct form.)
—कच्छु-घ्नी, f. the plant
Trichosanthes Diœca; another plant, = हपुयाभेद.
—कच्छू-मती, f. the plant Carpopogon Pruriens,
said to cause itching on being applied to the skin.

कच्छुर, अस्, आ, अम्, scabby, itchy; unchaste,
libidinous; (आ), f. the plant Alhagi Maurorum; a
species of Curcuma; the plant Carpopogon Pruriens.
कच्छोर, अम्, n. a kind of Curcuma.

कच्वी कच्वी, f. a plant with an esculent
root (Arum Colocasia) cultivated for food.
काचक, अस्, m. glass, a stone; alkaline ashes &c.

काचन or काचनक, अम्, n. an enclosure, a
string or tape which ties a parcel or bundle of papers
or the leaves of a manuscript &c.; [cf. कचेल.]
काचनकिन्, ई, m. a writing, a manuscript.
काचित, अस्, आ, अम्, suspended by a swing or in a loop.

काचिघ काचिघ, अस्, m. a mouse, a rat;
gold; a vegetable.

काचिञ्चिक काचिञ्चिक (a various reading for
काकचिञ्चिक), a kind of soft substance.

काचित्कर काचित्-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. doing
various things, serving various purposes; (का-चित्,
Ved. for कानि-चित्.)

काचिम काचिम, अस्, m. a tree considered
as sacred, one growing near a temple, and being on
that account an object of religious veneration or
worship &c.

काचिलिन्दि काचिलिन्दि and काचिलिन्दिक (va-
rious readings for काकचिञ्चिक), a kind of soft substance.

काच्छिक, अस्, ई, अम्, being on the bank of a river
(as a man).

काच्छप काच्छप, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कच्छप),
relating or belonging to a tortoise.

काच्छिम काच्छिम, अस्, आ, अम्, clear (as
water); [cf. अच्छ, स्वच्छ.]

काच्छी काच्छी, f. a kind of fragrant earth;
[cf. काक्षी from which काच्छी is derived.]
